_comment: Copy to data/z24/z24_config.json and fill in every field from the environmental monitoring system description in your own copy of the Z24 archive. That description is confidential; never commit the filled-in file.
channels: accelerometer suffix of each hourly .aaa file, for example the two digits before .aaa
name_origin: date of week one, day A in the WWDHH record names, ISO format
deck_temperatures: labels of the deck-top temperature columns in the .env files
pavement_temperatures: labels of the pavement temperature columns
air_temperature: label of the air temperature column
humidity: label of the relative humidity column
wind_speed: label of the wind speed column
